//Kafka: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY secrets. Outside Development supply them from the environment (e.g. Kafka__SaslPassword) or a secret store.
//OnboardingOutcomeSubscriber: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY secret. Outside Development supply OnboardingOutcomeSubscriber__ClientSecret from the environment or a secret store.

OnboardingOutcomeSubscriber.//TransientRetryMaxDelaySeconds: DEVELOPMENT: a message waiting for a dependency is retried at least every 10 s (production: 60, appsettings.json), so an API reopened at the fault proxy - or restarted - is used again within seconds and the saga's reply timers are not outrun.
OnboardingOutcomeSubscriber.//CustomerOnboardingApiBaseUrl: Development: through the fault proxy (route customer-onboarding-api, ps/toxiproxy/toxiproxy.json), so operations can cut it on Simulator & Fault Controls. appsettings.json holds the API's own address, used everywhere else.
